limitations: Metres; +X east, +Z north, Y vertical. Shared partition centre-line extents. Envelope 60 by 42 m. The consumer MUST omit all three upper slabs across it and roof above floor 4; never fill the outer envelope with an upper slab.

Two separated stairs, a passenger lift and a freight/service lift stack exactly as reservations only. They contain no physical stairs, landings, shafts or cars and do not establish vertical access. No escalators are modeled or implied.

access_to lists intended access across actual shared positive-length boundaries only. There is no hidden opening count, storefront family or swing target. Shop, food and leisure labels differ meaningfully by level; program totals exclude circulation and core reservations.

This compact centre uses shared galleries for service movement: no independent back-of-house service ring is modeled. Receiving, stock, waste, food preparation and security need controlled thresholds and time-separated delivery management; service segregation is a disclosed limitation, not verified performance.

Restaurant envelopes include unpartitioned cooking/seating allowances, with shared catering support separately labeled. Food queues and seating must remain within program zones, not the 3 m circulation backbone. Shops may intentionally have blind external walls; atrium shopfronts are not exterior daylight windows.

Review customer access versus service/privacy, storefront host cuts, delivery routes without crossing unrelated tenants, food-court queue clearance, atrium edge protection and no doors into voids. No doors, windows or opening families supplied. No capacity, smoke-control, structural or regulatory claim; not live-audited.
